messages:
Sam: Heads up — we just saw another VPC peering flap affecting Iris (dedicated/private) during a heavy KV cache sync. Same symptom as last month (packet drops, retransmits, short-lived control plane disconnect). Can we treat this as a regression chain rather than a one-off?
Lina: Ugh. Which peering pair? remote CIDR or onprem appliance?
Sam: peering pair iris-prod <-> onprem-nyc-2, CIDR 10.48.0.0/16. Hit rate-limited retransmits at ~13:07 UTC, ~30s of high drop. logs attached to incident ticket.
Chris: I pulled the logs — looks like BGP keepalive jitter coincident with a KV checkpoint. Timing lines up with our batching window. Might be congestion spike on customer edge.
Ajay: Could be the same MTU mismatch we fixed for Nova last quarter. Any traces from the customer's firewall?
Maria: Iris ops says they applied a firmware patch last week, but we saw the first occurrence after the patch. They're pushing me to prioritize.
Sam: Ops-bot posted the incident export: `incident/2345678000/export-logs.tar.gz` (link).
Lina: Proposed immediate triage: 1) assign remediation owner, 2) collect pcap + BGP counters for next occurrence, 3) test controlled KV checkpoint at low traffic. Who owns?
Chris: I'll take remediation owner for the incident chain. Will coordinate with Iris network and our runtime infra. Owner: Chris.
Ajay: I'll do the packet capture hooks and add netflow/BGP counters to the peering alert rule. ETA for hooks: EOD tomorrow.
Maria: I'll set up a customer-facing update and coordinate onprem appliance logs. Also looping in Solutions Eng to get access.
Sam: Action items recorded: 1) Chris — root-cause lead and customer coord (due in 3 business days). 2) Ajay — packet capture + alerting changes (due EOD tomorrow). 3) Maria — customer communication + log ingestion (due 1 business day). 4) Lina — add the incident to the "recurring-peering-regressions" board and tag with Iris and onprem-nyc-2.
Chris: Quick note — this looks like a recurring pattern across multiple customers (Iris, Kestrel, Helix). I recommend we create a short-lived working group: infra + runtime + customer netops to validate two mitigations: a) staggered KV checkpoint timing to avoid simultaneous large flows, b) dynamic pacing when peering RTT or loss > threshold.
Lina: Agreed. I'll spin up the WG and propose a 2-week sprint for mitigations & tests.
Ajay: For the alerting change, suggestion: new rule triggers when (BGP flaps OR retransmit rate > 1%) AND KV checkpoint in last 60s. That reduces noise.
Maria: Customer-facing note draft: "We're investigating intermittent peering disruption during KV syncs; we've assigned an owner and will share mitigations within 3 business days." I'll post after Chris confirms timeline.
Chris: Confirmed. I'll join the WG and own the RCA doc.
ops-bot: Reminder: create a postmortem ticket with label `recurring-peering` and attach all logs. Use template `pm-onprem-peering-v1`.
Sam: OK — moving to the postmortem follow-up checklist: 1) RCA doc link, 2) mitigation patch (stagger/pacing), 3) alerting rule, 4) cross-customer runbook for onprem peering (ownership assigned). Who wants to track the checklist?
Lina: I'll track the checklist and run the weekly follow-up until mitigations are verified.
Chris: I'll start the RCA doc and post the first draft in #incidents-wg by tomorrow.
Ajay: I'll add the capture hooks and rule to the observability repo; PR will reference incident/2345678000.
Maria: I'll send the customer update after draft review.
Sam: One last thing — recurring incident patterns: Lina, can you add retrospective item to evaluate whether our default KV checkpoint window should be reduced for private/dedicated with peered networks? Might be a tuning knob to avoid cross-customer collisions.
Lina: Added to sprint backlog as `KV-window-tuning-for-peered-deploys`.
Chris: Logging action: include `kv.checkpoint.size` and `kv.checkpoint.start_ts` in our peering telemetry for 90 days so we can correlate.
Ajay: Noted. I'll add those fields to the capture template.
Maria: Thanks everyone. I'll keep Iris updated and post any immediate customer-provided captures here.
Sam: Closing thread for now — WG invites forthcoming. :thumbsup:
